entries.21cea1e9e2da184f: This segment manufactures and sells electric wires and cables, wire harnesses, new energy-related products, and harness processing machinery and parts in Japan. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥24,000 million. Demand increased in environment-related markets, while other markets were affected by delayed recovery in some market conditions and inventory adjustments by customers. It includes the company and consolidated subsidiaries such as Onamba Interconnect Technology Co., Ltd. and Union Machinery Co., Ltd.

entries.53f15cd0eebf5325: This segment manufactures, processes and sells electric wires in Asian countries including China, Vietnam, Indonesia and Thailand. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥8,536 million. While the Chinese market continued to be sluggish, demand recovered at some customers. It includes consolidated subsidiaries such as Ounanba Dianzi Peijian (Kunshan) Co., Ltd., VIETNAM ONAMBA CO.,LTD. and PT. ONAMBA INDONESIA.
